periods.time: Stella and Ikki's arrival in Vermillion
periods.label: 欢迎一辉的皇后

name.jp: アストレア・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: supports Stella and Ikki's relationship while disciplining Sirius
status.condition: gentle but frighteningly possessive toward her husband

relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter whom she warmly welcomes home and supports.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Prospective son-in-law; thanks him for fighting Stella seriously and helping her grow.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband whom she terrifies whenever he shows improper affection toward Stella or schemes.

periods.summary: Astrea personally welcomes Stella and Ikki at the airport, appearing so youthful that Ikki mistakes her for Stella's sister. She thanks Ikki for giving Stella a real rival and boyfriend, and she is generally supportive of their relationship. In the royal castle she repeatedly restrains Sirius, first when he tries to kiss Stella and later when his anti-Ikki plot is exposed. Her soft manner hides intense jealousy and enough authority to make the king obey.

key_events.summary: Welcomes Ikki, unaware that citizens and Sirius are about to attack him.
Helps pressure Sirius into accepting Ikki's trial.

periods.time: Vermillion royal crisis during Quedland invasion
periods.label: 理性辅佐情义的王妃

name.jp: アストレア・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂实际内政与外交主导者

status.current: paralyzed in the palace by Ein's Sleep Beauty pollen but alive
status.condition: unable to move during Ein's attack

relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband; she criticizes his reckless choices but supports the heart behind them.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter; challenges her with the political cost of revealing Quedland's control.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Daughter whose injury and disappearance cause concern.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law candidate; encourages him after seeing his respect for Sirius' feelings.

periods.summary: Astrea watches Sirius' foolish tests of Ikki with affectionate exasperation and supports Ikki because he understands a parent's attachment to a child. In the palace crisis she first takes the rational position that telling front-line soldiers Quedland is being controlled would endanger Vermillion lives by making them hesitate. Sirius overrules her, choosing emotional obligation over state logic, and Astrea accepts his decision, explaining that Vermillion itself was founded by choosing duty to suffering people over formal reason. She then turns to practical planning for stopping the army without killing. During Ein's infiltration, Astrea recognizes the flower poison's nature but is paralyzed by it.

key_events.summary: Observes and softens the family conflict around Ikki's acceptance.
Argues the rational danger of telling soldiers the truth, then supports Sirius' contrary decision.
Falls victim to Ein's pollen paralysis during the palace assassination attempt.

periods.time: After Ein's palace attack and before the representative war
periods.label: 王妃的善后与代表承认

status.current: handles palace aftermath and supports the citizens' vigil offscreen

relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband; he says she is handling palace cleanup after the attack.
relationships.yui-tatara: Accepts Tatara into the representative roster after Tatara's palace help.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Daughter whose evacuation effort she supports.

periods.summary: Astrea is largely offscreen in this volume but remains important in the political aftermath. Sirius reports that she and the palace are safe after the unexpected helper stopped Dirty Rose and that Astrea is handling the cleanup. Tatara later says she used her role in saving the palace to request the final representative slot, and Astrea agreed. On the eve of war, Lunaeyes says she and Astrea have repeatedly tried to convince the citizens to evacuate, but the people refuse and prepare a funeral vigil instead.

key_events.summary: Approves Tatara as the fifth representative after the palace incident.
Attempts to persuade citizens to evacuate before the vigil.

periods.time: Vermillion funeral night and first representative-war phase
periods.label: 见证女儿们法米利昂热血的王妃

name.jp: アストレア・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: watching the representative war from Vermillion and recognizing Lunaeyes's hidden heat
status.goal: support her family and country through the crisis

personality.summary: Gentle and politically aware, yet perceptive about the fiery hearts shared by her husband and daughters.

relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband; she both supports and teases his paternal loneliness.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Daughter whose renunciation Astrea worries about politically but ultimately understands emotionally.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter whose battlefield burden she watches with fear and trust.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future family candidate present when Astrea brings League news.

periods.summary: Astrea arrives in haste during the funeral wake to deliver urgent news from League headquarters to Sirius and Ikki, triggering awareness of the border crisis. Later, when Lunaeyes announces she will renounce Vermillion's succession, Astrea is alarmed and argues that Lunaeyes has the qualities Vermillion needs precisely because she balances the country's impulsive spirit. She initially suspects Lunaeyes is discouraged by Stella's popularity, but Sirius identifies John as the real reason. Astrea watches Lunaeyes admit that she wants to stay beside John, then accepts the decision after Sirius grants permission. During the war broadcast, Astrea sees Lunaeyes personally rescue John and concludes that she had misread her elder daughter: Lunaeyes is not simply like Astrea, but also carries the same hot Vermillion blood as Sirius and Stella. She shares that relief with Sirius while also teasing him that a daughter's 'I love you' often includes convenience.

key_events.summary: Brings the urgent League report to Sirius and Ikki during the funeral wake.
Flashback and war viewing show her accepting Lunaeyes's choice to follow John.

periods.time: Final war broadcast and postwar hospital visit
periods.label: 温柔支撑家人的法米利昂王妃

name.jp: アストレア・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: alive and supporting Stella, Sirius, and Ikki in the hospital aftermath
status.condition: relieved by Ikki's revival and focused on urgent postwar issues
status.goal: keep her family steady and bring Stella to Tatara before she leaves

personality.summary: Warm, perceptive and practical, able to tease gently while stopping Sirius's outbursts when duty calls.
fears: Sirius derailing serious moments with jealousy

relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter whose growth and grief she watches closely.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband whom she reins in by force when needed.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law figure; she warmly welcomes his revival and calls him a Vermillion hero.
relationships.yui-tatara: Her attempted departure brings Astrea to alert Stella.

periods.summary: Astrea watches Ikki's battle with Alice beside Sirius and initially hopes Ikki has won after his massive combination attack. Sirius's severe expression lets her realize the fight remains dangerous because Alice's Invincible Armor can erase the damage. After the war, Astrea comes to Ikki's hospital room with Sirius looking for Stella. She warmly celebrates Ikki's awakening, teases the embarrassed couple after interrupting their kiss, and calls Ikki a hero whom Vermillion will someday repay. When Sirius starts raging over Ikki kissing Stella, Astrea painfully restrains him and redirects attention to the urgent matter: Tatara is leaving the hospital and the country. Her warning sends Stella to the airport in time to catch Fia before departure.

key_events.summary: Watches the duel with Sirius and learns why Alice remains dangerous.
Visits Ikki's room, celebrates his revival, and warns Stella about Tatara leaving.
Her warning enables Stella to intercept Tatara at the airport.

periods.time: Stella rescue crisis and postwar wedding planning
periods.label: 地下国王的冷静判断

name.jp: アストレア・ヴァーミリオン

personality.summary: Astrea is perceptive, politically sharp and candid. She doubts Itsuki because of past Kurogane conduct, but apologizes once she understands his parental and political resolve.
flaws: initial suspicion of Itsuki due to his reputation and past conduct

relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter whose danger she grasps immediately as not protected by hostage logic.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Husband; has him removed from the call when rage prevents discussion.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Negotiates with him and apologizes for mistrusting his intent.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Daughter present during the crisis call.
relationships.john-cobland: Asks him to restrain Sirius so the adults can speak.

periods.summary: Astrea takes over the call with Itsuki after Sirius erupts, immediately recognizing that Itsuki contacted Vermillion before the Union meeting for a strategic reason, not mere courtesy. She understands that if Eilands acts for personal goals, Stella's safety is not protected by hostage bargaining, and that Union procedure would waste time. She questions why Japan would risk so much for Stella, then accepts Itsuki's answer and apologizes for assuming he was rigid and unfeeling. Later, she is implied to be central to the swift wedding arrangements and rumored political motive of securing Ikki for Vermillion before other countries court him.

key_events.summary: Calmly negotiates with Itsuki over Union strategy for rescuing Stella.
Is associated with the rapid arrangement of Ikki and Stella's Vermillion wedding.
